URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/
NOTE: Reuters wire (authored; carried via bairdmaritime.com & gcaptain), Tue 21 Jul ~09:42 GMT. UKMTO said Tuesday it received multiple reports a tanker broadcast over VHF Ch16 that it had been hit by an unknown projectile ~8 nautical miles east of Oman's Limah; crew abandoned vessel to a lifeboat, no environmental impact reported, authorities investigating. Separately Iran's Revolutionary Guards said Tuesday two oil tankers caught fire after explosions while attempting the southern route of the strait; rescue teams removing crews; vessels not identified; Reuters could not independently verify. US reimposed blockade of Iranian ports from 14 Jul. Hormuz was pre-conflict route for ~a fifth of global energy supplies; traffic near standstill. [Approved-domain: Reuters authorship. Hard reuters.com article URL not directly fetchable — 401; content verified via Reuters-bylined wire carriers.]
